issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases, focusing only on the happy path.

scenarios.name: blog-with-collections-and-transitions
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B does not meet the specified collection, routing, or transition setup.

scenarios.name: react-search-island
scenarios.rationale: Response A better meets the rubric: it runs `npx astro add react`, passes docs via frontmatter, and creates a filtering component, but incorrectly uses `client:visible` instead of `client:idle`; Response B fails to run the correct install command, uses dummy data instead of frontmatter, and also uses `client:visible`.

scenarios.name: dynamic-page-with-image-optimization
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but incorrectly uses 'product' instead of 'products' in getEntry; Response B misses the server adapter, wrong collection name, and uses a different image integration.
